title: Shared pieces used by the other contracts
description: Contract set v2 (hub v0.3.0, Night HUD). Changes need the overseer and a version bump.

iso.description: ISO 8601 date-time, local time unless it carries an offset

source.description: Where a claim came from. Always shown as icon + word. `unexpected` marks a source he might not expect; `snippet` is the evidence shown on tap.

confidence.description: Shown in words. Sure is hidden by default; Guess gets a dotted underline.

src.description: Where the picture is: /api/thumb/<key>.webp, or a path inside ui/

alt.description: What the picture shows, in words; never empty

thumb.description: A small picture of a thing, always shown with its label. Cached outside git.

glance.description: The glance code (HUD v2 §5): each has its own shape, colour and word.

slot.description: A Rail slot: Your yes, Today, Homework, Messages, Jarvis, Parked.
